why: A tagged Resolved line in a motion with no labels was collapsed under the mover; the source's (proc text) tag wins, so it is a no-speaker PROCEDURAL row and nothing is credited to the mover.
title: Adjournment
html:
[(proc text) Resolved, "That Parliament do now adjourn." – [Ms Indranee Rajah]. (proc text)]

Adjourned accordingly at 6.49 pm.
